Check the current INCOIS PFZ advisory map and text for the latest information on potential fishing zones in the Maharashtra sector. For Palghar district-specific information, refer to the Palghar District Strategic Plan 2023, which reports on the district's fisheries production and named landing centres. However, this plan is a historical document and does not provide current information on fishing conditions or availability.

parsed_response.answer:
For current Palghar fisheries advisories, please check the INCOIS Potential Fishing Zone Advisory map/text at https://www.incois.gov.in/MarineFisheries/PfzAdvisory. The validity of this advisory may vary, and it is recommended to verify its accuracy.

The Palghar district fisheries profile and landing centres are available in the District Strategic Plan for Palghar 2023, which can be accessed at https://abhinavpahal.nic.in/visions_doc/489VBcyu4MPalgharDSP1July2024.pdf. This document provides historical information on the district's fisheries and does not reflect current conditions.

Please note that the district's published preparedness material, including the District Disaster Management Plan and the Palghar Heat Action Plan, is available at https://palghar.gov.in/en/disaster-management/. These documents provide general information on disaster management and preparedness but are not real-time warnings or advisories.

In an immediate emergency, contact the Palghar District Disaster Management control room at 02525-297474 or toll-free 1077, or the Maharashtra Disaster Management control room at 022-22027990, or the National Disaster Management Authority control room at 011-26701728.
